question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cheap
solution:
The correct answer is: **Expensive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cheap"** means something that is low in cost or price. (सस्ता)

 
 
• **Example: **The store offers a variety of **cheap **products that are affordable for everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Expensive"** refers to something that costs a lot of money. (महंगा)
 
 
• **Example: **The diamond necklace was too **expensive **for her to afford.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Cheap'** is **'Expensive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignorant** (अज्ञानी): Lacking knowledge or awareness in general; uneducated or unsophisticated.

 
 
• **Example:** He was **ignorant **of the local customs and made several mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Old** (पुराना): Having lived for a long time; no longer young.
 
 
• **Example:** The **old **man walked slowly with the help of a cane.
 
 
 
• **Untangle** (सुलझाना): To make something that is complicated or confusing easier to deal with.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent hours trying to **untangle **the knots in the string.
